newsitem.title: USA: Dow gains more than 50 points.
newsitem.headline: Dow gains more than 50 points.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average gained more than 50 points in mid-morning trading on Tuesday, boosted by positive data in the National Association of Purchasing Management's report.
At 10:33 a.m. EDT, the index of 30 blue-chip issues rose 56.32 points at 7,729.11, which activated the New York Stock Exchange's limits on program trading.
